raw_response:
This plot is small, just over a third of a hectare, and I grow what my family can eat and sell a little. I have no money for chemical fertilizer — in Tabora the fertilizer is costly and hard to find, and I did not learn such things. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, as my father did. My wife and I will do the work ourselves with the hoe, and maybe I call a neighbor for a few days when the weeds come fast after the rains.
